source_note: docs/content-drafts/neet-ug-eligibility.md -- DRAFT RESEARCH, not verified, not published (see that file's own header). The two facts below (minimum age relative to a 31-December cutoff, and the any-of Biology/Biotechnology subject requirement) are each independently confirmed twice in the draft (the official information bulletin plus the primary Gazette regulation/corrigendum) -- the best-sourced facts in that draft -- but still require RULES-12's named human reviewer against the current cycle's own bulletin before reviewed_by/reviewed_on above may be filled in; until then this rule set is excluded from a production-mode registry listing (app.rules.ruleset.RuleSet.is_reviewed). The draft explicitly recommends publishing no minimum_marks_percentage, no maximum_age and no domicile_states claim for this exam (each is either 'not found' after checking both the bulletin and the primary regulation, or -- for the upper age limit -- sourced only to two NMC letters the draft could not independently confirm), so none of those appear in "facts" below; see "not_checked" instead.

not_checked.name: Minimum marks percentage in the qualifying (Class 12) examination
not_checked.note: Not found in either the official information bulletin or the primary regulation checked for this draft -- not checked here. A commonly repeated figure exists on third-party sites but could not be confirmed against a primary source; confirm with the official notification for your cycle.

not_checked.name: Qualifying percentile (for admission, not for eligibility to appear)
not_checked.note: This is a result of the exam, not an input a student has, and must never be turned into a score or rank prediction -- not checked here.

not_checked.name: Domicile / nationality for state-quota seats
not_checked.note: Delegated to each state's own notifications and not modelled here -- confirm with the relevant state counselling authority.

cases.name: meets_well_before_cutoff_with_biology
cases.reason: Turns 17 well before the 31 Dec 2027 cutoff and has Physics, Chemistry and Biology.

cases.name: meets_with_biotechnology_instead_of_biology
cases.reason: The any-of group accepts Biotechnology as an alternative to Biology.

cases.name: does_not_meet_neither_biology_nor_biotechnology
cases.reason: Age is fine, but neither Biology nor Biotechnology was studied.

cases.name: does_not_meet_missing_chemistry
cases.reason: Chemistry, its own required group, is missing.

cases.name: does_not_meet_too_young
cases.reason: Will not have completed the minimum age by the 31 Dec 2027 cutoff.

cases.name: meets_exact_boundary_on_cutoff_day
cases.reason: Turns the minimum age exactly on the 31 Dec 2027 cutoff day, which meets, not fails.

cases.name: does_not_meet_one_day_after_cutoff_birthday
cases.reason: Turns the minimum age one day after the 31 Dec 2027 cutoff.

cases.name: insufficient_information_unknown_date_of_birth
cases.reason: Date of birth is not given, so the age cutoff can't be checked -- must never be treated as a failure.

cases.name: insufficient_information_unknown_subjects
cases.reason: Subjects studied are not given, so the any-of group can't be checked.

cases.name: insufficient_information_both_unknown
cases.reason: Neither date of birth nor subjects studied are given.

cases.name: does_not_meet_wins_over_unknown_subjects
cases.reason: A definite age failure must not be masked by the unrelated unknown subjects.

cases.name: insufficient_information_stale_cycle_masks_a_would_be_meets
cases.reason: as_of is past the 2027 cycle's cycle_end -- a would-be meets is downgraded so a lapsed cycle is never reported as a confident pass.

cases.name: does_not_meet_survives_a_stale_cycle
cases.reason: A real failure found under a lapsed cycle's rules is still true information and must not be hidden by the staleness downgrade.

cases.name: meets_with_all_optional_subjects_also_present
cases.reason: Extra subjects beyond the required groups don't change a meets.
